one_line_thesis: Japan asset manager and ETF group: FY26 AUM ¥1.34tn with success fees +53.6%; at last print ¥464 and ¥137 mid-cycle owner cash the synthesis return is 53.33% per year, but watch for illiquid tape and peak performance-fee earnings.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Simplex is a Japan asset manager and ETF group reported as a single investment-management segment (ETF and fund fees roll up in filings). We classify it as a croupier with partial moat: FY2026 ROE near 59% and AUM ¥1.34 trillion, but success fees drove more than half of fee revenue and are cyclical. At ¥464 (last thin print) and ¥137.14 per share mid-cycle owner cash (FY2025 split-adjusted EPS, not FY2026 peak ¥317.33), the seven-year synthesis expected annual return is 53.33% per year after filing review (Lawrence base 50.3%). Bear 43.0% and bull 58.7% bracket scenarios. Dhando is partial....

pricing_analysis.conclusion: Hurdle prices are derived from the decision-grade universal contract; they do not constitute a capital decision.

decision.next_action: Close the committee's primary-evidence blockers before requesting an owner decision.

Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.
